compile_result: both sources compile as ELF32 ARM EABI5 relocatable objects with -ffreestanding -fPIC -Os -Wall -Wextra -Werror
link_blocker: The development environment has Clang's ARM compiler but no ARM-capable ld.lld or arm-none-eabi-ld; Apple's host linker rejects ARM relocatable linking.
caveat: The shims are probe code only. Canon-native allocator, HTTP, and scanner callbacks remain unresolved, and no firmware image was generated.
